usage: 護照 (passport) is a noun used to refer to the official document required for international travel.
You can use 護照 when talking about the need to show identification at the airport.
The word 護照 stays the same whether you’re talking about your own passport or someone else’s.
In casual conversation, people often ask “有冇帶護照？” to check if you have brought your passport.
When describing actions with 護照, verbs like '攞' (to take), '帶' (to bring), or '申請' (to apply) are commonly used.
